title: Rose Henderson
description:
Rose began her theatre education while at school and honed her classical and voice training through performance and voice-over work. She studied at the New York School of Polish Mime and crafted a career in theatre of the absurd, comedy and physical theatre. Appreciated across generations from young people's programmes right through to the current cinema release of Abode and Dear Imdelda. 

Creators of the new iconic role of Sister Assumpta in Father Ted, Rose embodied Val in the serial drama Fair City through 7 seasons. More recently, Rose has brought to theatres in Ireland acclaimed plays focusing on tough topics: Take Off Your Cornflakes (Alzheimers), Vixen (extra marital affairs) The Good Crank (grief).

title: Dára O' Cearbhulain
description:
Spanning a career as an actor writer and director and presently a lecturer in Irish plays in Espirito Santos Brazil,  Dára is a Director/ Dramaturg. 

As a commissioned Director he specialises in Theatre of the Opressed, the works of Samuel Beckett and Sean O'Casey 

A graduate of the London Guildhall, previous productions include "The Risen People", "Juno and the Paycock", "Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf"  and the seminal works of Arthur Miller. 

Commissioned productions include the celebration of the Centenary of the St. Laurence O'Toole Pipe Band, the opening of the Sean O'Casey Theatre, East Wall and Assistant to the creative  directors of The Special Olympics when hosted in Ireland. 

Dára has been the Artistic Director of The O'Reilly / James Joyce Theatre Dublin and was an Executive Producer of a year of centenary celebrations of The Abbey Theatre including the performance on the centenary date which was sold out within ten minutes of the ticket launch. 

He is a national theatre award winner. The recipient of The Lincoln Prize, New York and recently his own work was awarded The Kimmel Prize in Phlladelphia USA.
